title: CCTV Exoneration — PDI Confirms No Aggression, Then Conceals Finding

segments.speaker: PDI-OF
segments.verbatim_es: cuando le dices que no hay agresion como ustedes vieron en camara y todo eso
segments.translation_en: when you tell him that there is no aggression as you have seen on camera and all that..
segments.transcription_notes: Spelling 'agression' / 'quando' / 'hai' is verbatim; speaker code-switching with Portuguese influence.

segments.speaker: PDI-OF
segments.verbatim_es: vas a denunciar como persona natural, no como LATAM
segments.translation_en: You're going to be filing as your person... NOT AS LATAM.....okay?!
segments.transcription_notes: Speaker label 'PDI/Latam BOSS' reflects transcriber uncertainty.

segments.speaker: PDI-OF
segments.verbatim_es: en este caso por ese lado no hay lesiones
segments.translation_en: In this case, on that side, there are no injuries.

segments.speaker: PDI-OF
segments.verbatim_es: pero realmente agresion a una persona no hay
segments.translation_en: **But really, an aggression against a person....there is none

segments.speaker: PDI-OF
segments.verbatim_es: el tema de desembarque para declarar pasajero disruptivo
segments.translation_en: **And the issue obviously of...disembarkation and that.. for it to be a disruptive passenger...as declared.. (ICAO?)...

segments.speaker: PDI-OF
segments.verbatim_es: pasajero disruptivo no lo vi y no lo declaro
segments.translation_en: **Ehh right, in that sense..right, disruptive passenger..I didn't see it.... I don't declare it**
segments.transcription_notes: PDI officer expressly declines the 'disruptive passenger' framing.

segments.speaker: PDI-OF
segments.verbatim_es: por ese motivo podemos tomar denuncia personal no como LATAM
segments.translation_en: **** For that reason we can take a complaint from you but it's as your person, not as LATAM..
segments.transcription_notes: 'Por ese motivo' verbalises the causal nexus between the no-aggression finding and the coaching.

segments.speaker: PDI-OF
segments.verbatim_es: voy a informar a la DGAC y lamentamos que hayas perdido tu vuelo
segments.translation_en: Okay Leandro, I'm going to file the report with the Civil Aviation Directorate, we regret you've lost your flight, this decision was not made by us

segments.speaker: PDI-OF
segments.verbatim_es: en sistema quedara que llegaste a la hora y que no hay denuncia en tu contra
segments.translation_en: they in the system are going to have that you arrived on time, that there's no complaint against you...

established_articles.verbatim_excerpt: 8.° Ocultando en perjuicio del Estado o de un particular cualquier documento oficial.
established_articles.applicability_rationale: PDI officers had a duty to memorialise the CCTV-review finding in an official parte. The verbal finding at seg-55, made in execution of their office, was an act of the office; its non-inclusion in the parte mentioned at seg-75, combined with the immediately preceding coaching at seg-45/seg-62, supports the modality of ocultación under numeral 8.

established_articles.verbatim_excerpt: Art. 211. El que imputare falsamente a alguna persona haber cometido un crimen o simple delito, siendo sabedor de la falsedad de la imputación, o el que la hiciere de malicia, incurrirá en las penas de reclusión menor en sus grados mínimo a medio y multa de once a quince unidades tributarias mensuales.
established_articles.applicability_rationale: Invoked not against PDI but as the predicate offence whose falsity was established by PDI's own CCTV review (seg-55). Anchors materiality of the Art. 193(8) concealment.

element_grids.article_short: Art. 193 N° 8 CP — ocultación de documento oficial por empleado público

elements.label: Sujeto activo: empleado público
elements.argument_es: Los funcionarios 'PDI-OF' son oficiales de PDI, empleados públicos bajo Art. 260 CP y DL 2.460.

elements.label: Abuso del oficio
elements.argument_es: La revisión del CFTV, la toma o no-toma de denuncia, y la emisión del parte a DGAC son actos del servicio.

elements.label: Acto del oficio cuya constancia debía generarse
elements.argument_es: La revisión del CFTV es diligencia investigativa; el deber funcional (CPP Art. 175 ss.) obliga a consignar su resultado en el parte.

elements.label: Modalidad típica: ocultación
elements.argument_es: Tres actos: directiva a LATAM (seg-45/seg-62), conjunción causal 'por ese motivo' admitiendo dolo, parte sin mención del hallazgo (seg-75).
weaknesses: seg-75 omission depends on OQ-CL005-PDI-PARTE for full proof

elements.label: Objeto material: documento oficial
elements.argument_es: Si el parte se emitió y omitió el hallazgo, es ocultación por omisión de contenido. Sin verificar OQ-CL005-PDI-PARTE el elemento queda contested.
weaknesses: Depends on doctrine of 'ocultación por omisión de contenido' — needs verified authority
seg-177 'no hay denuncia en tu contra' admits a benign reading too

elements.label: Perjuicio a un particular
elements.argument_es: Pérdida del vuelo, remoción, prohibición y narrativa continuada (CL-007, CL-016, CL-017).

elements.label: Tipicidad subjetiva: dolo
elements.argument_es: 'Por ese motivo' en seg-62 verbaliza directamente el nexo mental entre lo sabido y lo decidido.

nexus_matrix.rationale_oneline: Speaker label 'PDI-OF' identifies actor as empleado público.
CCTV review performed in execution of police function at airport intervention.
Statement confirms finding produced in exercise of office.
Independent declination of ICAO 'disruptive passenger' framing.
'Por ese motivo' links the no-aggression finding to the personal-complaint directive.
Speaker attribution ambiguous; strength downgraded pending identification.
Passenger told of outcome without being told the exonerating finding.
No formal complaint reached the system — consistent with concealment thesis.
Passenger told he has lost flight without being told the concealed finding.
'Por ese motivo' verbalises the mental nexus — most direct dolo evidence.
